title: Illinois Business Registry Active Organizations
description: Governed privacy-minimized Illinois SOS Goodstanding/Reinstated corporation and LLC organization layer built only from operator-supplied official daily files.
coverage_claim: Corporations of documented types 4, 5, or 6 and LLCs whose source status is Goodstanding or Reinstated in one complete common-run-date five-file Illinois SOS snapshot; this is registration evidence, not a census of operating businesses or physical sites.
